i-stale-claims.note: 2026-10-16: verified on static evidence, the kind added that day for a row whose claim is the repository’s own text, and for no other. The owner’s brief of 2026-10-16 answered the decision this row waited on (docs/verification/CURRENT-SCOPE-2026-10-15.md, The Owner’s Decisions, 1) yes: a gate test that reads that text verifies such a row where it reaches the text the claim is about, checks it, and expects independently, with examples it must catch and examples it must accept, so it can’t pass vacuously. Read against that on 2026-10-16: tests/evidence3-person.test.ts’s four and tests/evidence2-b13.test.ts’s three meet it (each sentence they quote as an example is in the file as written, and each walk fails on an empty read); tests/evidence-g34-ui.test.ts’s three reach the text and support the row, with no example to catch or accept, the third on the first round’s rule. Until 2026-10-16 it was partial on the player-action standard, the note of 2026-10-15 reading: “2026-10-15: the skeptic found the prose and its rule hold, but the row’s tests read the repository’s text (tree walks and examples, recorded as fixtures, as at bef4bde5); the standard verifies a row only on a command, the clock or a rendered screen, so it stays partial. Whether a gate test reading the repository may verify a row about that text is the owner’s decision.”
